notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33531695/7444eb95374ced02f8d3c430def6329f36420cef.png[/img]

[h1][b]Fix List:[/b][/h1]

[list]
    [*]A Few Giant Monsters were falling off the ground due to it's massive size and players have been getting stuck in Boss area with blue wall. It's now FIXED! You will no longer get stuck in Boss Areas!
    [*]An invisible wall that blocks a stair into Boss Area in "Ancient Dungeon" is now removed!
    [*]Other minor bug fixes that our developers have found.
[/list]

[b]Please report to us if you encounter any bugs or problems with the game. We will fix it within 1-3 days/usually we upload the reported bug's fix in next 6 hours/ depending on the problem. We care about bug reports and suggestions with the game, so please do not hesitate to contact us via discord, discussion board, community group chat or our customer support email. Thank you![/b]

notes.title: New Feature & Bug Fix
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33531695/2f0c02011b7a0f54b9c693901ee1e868eba8784d.png[/img]

[h1][b]Lock System[/b][/h1]

Now you can lock a closest enemy to cursor with Left Alt/you can change the key at Keybinding option/. It will exit the lock mode if you press "Left Alt" again. If your Walk Key is configured with "Left Alt", please change the key of a lock target button or walk button. It will not work if keys overlap each other.

[h1][b]Shrine Bug[/b][/h1]

We still receive bug reports on shrines from a few players even though we fixed the locations of it. So we did a different approach on shrine's code. Now you should no longer have any troubles with shrines again.

notes.title: EA build is Live!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33531695/f1d7b0b644254fcfd50cd1103f80d7967eeb31ef.png[/img]

Liberty Prime EA build v0.7.0 is finally out!

[h1][b]Updates[/b][/h1]

We will be uploading new contents, features and bug fixes every week. Current EA build is only 3/5 of the full content and can take up to at least 10 hours of gameplay.

[h1][b]Join our Discord[/b][/h1]

Remember to join our discord server! If you find any bugs or feel like sharing your experience of the game with other players, here you can join our official Discord server: [url=https://discord.gg/U9smhdX]https://discord.gg/U9smhdX[/url]

Thanks so much for all your support. Early Access supporters mean a lot to us. Now go play the game already!

Kind Regards, Prime Team.

notes.title: Monster Tamer Tier 3!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33531695/34b2c2099ba2d036ba9a8bcbe75f1e2803d04d1b.png[/img]

Soon feature called "Monster Tamer" is going to be implemented into the game. You can summon tamed demons into the battle to fight alongside with you. Become Early Access Supporter and tame demons up to Tier 3! /Dragons, Giant Worms, Ancient Creatures, Colossus etc..../ In full release you can only tame Demons up to Tier 2.

Hurry to share this news with your friends, parents, neighbors, schoolmates and co-workers. They all need to know about it!

notes.title: Happy Demon Hunting!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33531695/0bc1ecad6265a940b1a17394f697bb455adb17df.png[/img]

Liberty Prime will enter Steam Early Access 21st September 2018. You can add the game to your wishlist on Steam today. One of the seven virtue is wishlisting "Liberty Prime" :) 

We’re eager to get more players into the game and continue to build Liberty Prime with the community during Early Access. Until then, here’s a message from our team: 

"Liberty Prime is a brutal and challenging game set during the Demon apocalypse. We designed it to appeal to the fans of Dungeon Crawlers but also modernized the design for new fans. We hope that all the blood, heart, and soul we put in the game shows as you play and dismember your enemies to take their blood, heart, and soul."
